consensus_points.headline: Temporary agent memory/audit files were committed in a 2712-file pipeline PR. That violates smallest-actionable artifact discipline and risks turning local session byproducts into canonical product state.
consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Delete committed temp/session byproducts, add deny/ignore coverage for `.omc/*.tmp.*` and `.audit/` where appropriate, and keep only smallest actionable evidence artifacts.

consensus_points.headline: Temporary agent memory, HUD, and audit scratch files were committed alongside canonical pipeline maturity work. For contributors, this blurs product evidence versus local session exhaust and creates a real risk that future agents cargo-cult transient state as…
consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Remove committed tmp/session byproducts from canonical history on the next cleanup PR, add deny/ignore coverage for `.omc/*.tmp.*`, `.omc/state/sessions/**/.hud-state.json.tmp.*`, and local `.audit/` scratch unless intentionally promoted, and document the pro…

consensus_points.headline: The review workflow is triggered by workflow_run, checks out the PR head SHA, and runs cargo from that checkout while the job has checks:write/actions:read permissions. That executes untrusted PR-controlled code in a privileged workflow_run context.
consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Do not run PR-head code in workflow_run with write permissions. Run analysis in a pull_request/read-only job, or have workflow_run execute only trusted default-branch code against downloaded artifacts, with a separate minimal status-poster step.

consensus_points.headline: PR #3 added/advanced M01-P17 implementation-plan content, but the current machine-readable masterplan live index still shows M-CC with phase_count 10 and has no M01-P17/P11 entries. Agents reading the canonical masterplan JSON cannot discover the pipeline-m…
consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Regenerate `/specs/cross-cutting/masterplan.json#live_implementation_index` after P10/P11 additions and add a lane assertion that every `.omc/plans/milestones/*/phases/*/INDEX.md` phase appears in the machine-readable hierarchy.

consensus_points.headline: Large plan hierarchy moves landed together with execution code, making it hard to distinguish canonical control-surface updates from historical narrative migration.
consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Use machine-readable masterplan diff checks to separate canonical state transitions from archival/documentation reshuffles.

consensus_points.headline: The workflow invokes `oya-intelligence-pr-review-dispatcher-app` without `--runtime-mode inline-deterministic-mock`. In the dispatcher code, default runtime mode is `External`, and `subagent_runtime_pending` remains true when no complete facet panel exists. That c…
consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Pass `--runtime-mode inline-deterministic-mock` with a deterministic user-message/change-id in CI, or stop claiming the gap is closed. Add a regression test/workflow assertion that produced rollup has `subagent_runtime_pending=false` before merge-queue admiss…

consensus_points.headline: `is_success(&ExitCode)` compares Debug-formatted strings to detect success. Debug output is not the stable contract of `std::process::ExitCode`; this is a brittle special case hidden inside the canonical shipping command.
consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Have the verifier return `Result<(), i32>` or a concrete status enum and convert to `ExitCode` only at the CLI boundary. Delete the Debug-string comparison.

consensus_points.headline: Runtime temp sidecars are committed into a PR that is supposedly consolidating canonical pipeline maturity. Temporary state files are not product state; they make the repository look dirtier and teach future agents that transient control-plane debris is accep…
consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Delete the `.tmp.*` files and add/verify ignore rules or atomic-write cleanup so runtime temp files cannot enter review again.

consensus_points.headline: The workflow parses JSON with grep/sed/awk to recover `verdict` and `subagent_runtime_pending`. That duplicates the dispatcher contract in shell text matching and will silently drift on formatting changes.
consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Make the dispatcher emit the check-run conclusion directly or emit a stable single-line machine output. If the workflow must read JSON, use one canonical parser path owned by the repo tooling.
